title: I’m in Charge at This Hertz Location, and Buddy, You’re Not Getting...
content: I’m in Charge at This Hertz Location, and Buddy, You’re Not Getting a Car Today. “Tell me, honestly, when you reserved a rental car through Hertz, you thought… what? That we were going to set aside a special little car just for you? Seriously?”
author: Jason Kottke
